crosh, debugd: fix handling of default values Some swap parameter setting commands used "0" to request a "default value". This was wrong in itself, because it precluded setting the parameters to 0. In addition, it didn't immediately restore the values to their factory defaults as promised, but only after a reboot. The "help" message also deserved some cleanup.
